errors.name: NotInitialized
errors.doc: Required registry configuration is missing from storage.

errors.name: AlreadyInitialized
errors.doc: Reserved for compatibility with the removed public initializer.

errors.name: AttesterNotAllowlisted
errors.doc: The caller is not allowlisted by the `attester-registry` contract.

errors.name: NoPendingTransfer
errors.doc: `accept_admin` was called with no pending admin transfer. Admin transfer is a two-step flow: the current admin must first call `propose_admin` to nominate a successor, then the nominated address must call `accept_admin` to complete the transfer. This error is returned when `accept_admin` is called before a corresponding `propose_admin` call has set a pending admin.

errors.name: InvalidRegistryWiring
errors.doc: The configured `attester-registry` address does not implement the expected interface. Re-run `set_attester_registry` with the correct address, or check your network configuration.

errors.name: AttestationNotFound
errors.doc: No attestation exists for the given record hash / sequence.

errors.name: ContractPaused
errors.doc: The requested operation is blocked while the contract is paused.

errors.name: InvalidAdminProposal
errors.doc: The proposed admin address is not a valid successor.

errors.name: ProposalExpired
errors.doc: The pending admin proposal has expired.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.doc: The attester has used up its rate-limit window. Call `get_rate_limit_retry_after` for the first ledger it may attest again.

errors.name: InvalidRateLimit
errors.doc: `window_ledgers` was `0` or longer than 30 days of ledgers.

errors.name: TtlExtensionOutOfRange
errors.doc: `extend_attestation_ttl` was called with an `extend_to` ledger that is not strictly greater than the entry's current live-until ledger, or that exceeds the maximum TTL horizon. TTL can only be extended, never shortened.

errors.name: QuorumPolicyNotConfigured
errors.doc: The record class has no quorum policy configured, so a co-attestation cannot be recorded against it. Configure a policy via `set_quorum_policy` first.

errors.name: DuplicateCoAttester
errors.doc: The attester has already co-attested this record. Quorum counts distinct attesters only; a repeated co-attestation from the same address is rejected as a no-op.

errors.name: InvalidQuorumPolicy
errors.doc: The supplied quorum policy is invalid (for example a required count of `0` or greater than the configured maximum).

errors.name: InvalidDisputeSignature
errors.doc: The patient dispute signature did not verify against the record commitment and the domain-separated dispute payload. Signatures are replay-safe via a per-record nonce and domain tag.

errors.name: DisputeLimitReached
errors.doc: The per-record dispute cap has been reached. Disputes are rate-limited to bound spam; an attester or admin must clear existing disputes before new ones can be filed.

errors.name: DisputeNotFound
errors.doc: No dispute overlay exists for the given record hash and signer, so it cannot be cleared.

errors.name: UnauthorizedDisputeClear
errors.doc: Only an allowlisted attester or the contract admin may clear a dispute flag.

errors.name: NotInitialized
errors.doc: `initialize` has not been called yet; call `initialize(admin: Address)` before using the contract.

errors.name: AlreadyInitialized
errors.doc: `initialize` was called more than once.

errors.name: NoPendingTransfer
errors.doc: `accept_admin` was called with no pending admin transfer. Admin transfer is a two-step flow: the current admin must first call `propose_admin` to nominate a successor, then the nominated address must call `accept_admin` to complete the transfer. This error is returned when `accept_admin` is called before a corresponding `propose_admin` call has set a pending admin.

errors.name: ContractPaused
errors.doc: The requested operation is blocked while the contract is paused.

errors.name: AllowlistFull
errors.doc: The allowlist is at its configured maximum size. Raise the cap via `set_max_attesters`, or free a slot via `remove_attester`.

errors.name: MigrationNotRequired
errors.doc: `migrate()` was called while the stored schema version is already `>= SCHEMA_VERSION`. Only call `migrate()` after `upgrade()` to a build that bumps `SCHEMA_VERSION`; this error is a safe no-op signal that there is nothing pending, not a failure to react to.

errors.name: AttesterNotFound
errors.doc: The referenced attester is not currently allowlisted (never added, or since removed).

errors.name: BatchTooLarge
errors.doc: The supplied batch exceeds `BATCH_LIMIT` addresses.
